assets.name: standing
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW canonical full-body character cutout for an existing personal website.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 Tall Character Design Concept Sheet.png is the mandatory rendering style, sculptural hair, wardrobe and very tall slender body proportion guide. Images 2–4 are photographs of the SAME real adult man and are the definitive facial likeness reference. Image 5 shows his naturally tall slim build. Reconcile the stylization with his actual identity, do not invent a generic handsome face.
Identity: long narrow adult male face, high forehead, dark swept short side-part hair elevated into sculptural locks as in sheet, long straight prominent nose, gently hooded brown eyes, characteristic brows, thin upper lip, quiet asymmetrical warm smile, elongated defined chin/jaw, light dark stubble, natural ears and subtle smile lines. Preserve mature facial structure from photos; no round face, big cartoon eyes or short nose.
Body: visibly VERY TALL, approximately 198 cm, exceptionally slim long-limbed adult, 8.5 to 9 heads in total height. Very long legs (over half total stature), long slender arms and fingers, narrow shoulders, slim torso, long slender neck. Match the full standing figure at far right of the concept sheet. This is a tall character built correctly from scratch, not a stretched short character. Avoid a giant head, short legs, stocky torso, muscular build.
Wardrobe: plain charcoal crewneck lightweight sweatshirt with subtle off-white collar peeking out, slim charcoal trousers, off-white minimalist sneakers, exactly the concept sheet. Render polished high-end stylized 3D with tactile cloth, warm natural skin and realistic eye detail, soft studio sunlight.
One single full body man only, relaxed standing three-quarter view toward right, one hand subtly open in welcome, other relaxed. Entire hair and both shoes visible. Portrait 1024x1536 composition with margin around head and feet. Real transparent background (RGBA alpha), no floor or backdrop, no glow, no lettering, no collage, no reference panels, no extra people.
